description: This file is a shell script that manages power modes and performs orderly shutdown and startup of RDKB (RDK Broadband) components. It includes functions for usage instructions, tearing down components, and starting up components based on the provided power mode.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information based on support for different power modes.

methods.name: PwrMgr_TearDownComponents
methods.description: Performs an orderly shutdown of specific RDKB components and processes.

methods.name: PwrMgr_StartupComponents
methods.description: Performs an orderly startup of specific RDKB components and processes.
